svg.aria-label: Why teamrig is different: A built-in project manager. One task list for the whole team: owner, priority, due date and proof. Your week, planned. Scheduled from your token budget; flags what's late, stuck or off-plan. Your day back (coming). One meeting in the morning. Each decision comes with a recommendation. Improves itself. What one session works out becomes a skill, and each lesson a team rule. Survives a crash or reboot (coming). Sessions reopen where they left off; tasks and notes are safe on disk. Just your terminal. Claude Code in the terminal you have. No IDE, no desktop app, no server.
